reason: Limit acceptable break fees by amount and duration.

proposed_change.old_text: - Prepayment permitted subject to a minimal 'break fee' (e.g., 1-2% of the principal) to compensate the lender for the administrative cost of the exit.
proposed_change.new_text: A break fee of 1-2% of prepaid principal may be accepted only during the first 12 months and must not apply after qualified financing, acquisition, or refinancing.
